transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?
I’ve been feeling low pretty much all the time for the last couple of years. Even at work, at church, or with people I care about, there’s this heavy, empty feeling that just doesn’t really go away.
Have you ever had periods lasting a few days or more where you felt the opposite—extremely energetic, euphoric, or irritable, with much less need for sleep?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed periods like that.
During these past two years, has your mood ever returned to completely normal for more than two months at a time?
No, I don’t think so. It’s been pretty constant for about two years and four months, since I had to stop my community-college classes because of money and my work schedule.
Before this period started about two years ago, had you ever experienced times in your life when you felt significantly depressed?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a time before this where I was significantly depressed like this.
During this time, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah. I’ve mostly stopped going to basketball, dance nights, and the church STEM mentoring I used to care about. It’s also affected work—I’ve gotten written warnings for missing shifts and turning in my inspection paperwork late.
How has your sleep been during this time?

I’m exhausted after being on the production floor all day, but then I get in bed and my mind just keeps going over everything I’m behind on. And when I do fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested.
Have you had any thoughts of wishing you were dead, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’m not sure what you mean by thoughts of hurting myself. I’ve been feeling really low, but I don’t know.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite?

Yeah. Most days I don’t really feel like eating and I’ll skip food until near the end of my shift. Other times I just grab vending machine snacks late because I’m wiped out. My weight’s been going up and down enough that my work pants fit differently month to month.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?
I’m not really sure. I know I’ve been feeling bad, but I don’t know if I’d call it worthlessness or guilt.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making everyday decisions?
I’m not sure. I guess I haven’t really noticed anything specific with that.
Have you been feeling hopeless about your future or that things won't get better?

Yeah… I mean, it’s been like this for a couple of years. I feel low pretty much all the time, even when I’m at work or at church or around people I care about. There’s this heavy, empty feeling that just doesn’t really go away, so it’s hard to feel like things will get better.
